title: Fire Event Toolkit: fire event delineation from burnt area mapping and satellite hotspots
description: Python implementation of the fire event delineation (FED) method described in Fisher et al. (2026), International Journal of Wildland Fire 35(10), WF26071. The toolkit combines high-resolution burnt area mapping with high temporal resolution hotspot data to produce day-of-burn attributed mapping (SAGA GIS Multilevel B-Spline interpolation clipped to monthly burnt areas), then delineates individual fire events by region growing and reports fire size distribution statistics.
